title: sweep.completed
description: A deposit address was emptied into the hot wallet. No user balance changed: a sweep moves the exchange's own custody between two of its own accounts, and the account whose address was swept sees nothing.

sweep_id.description: Stable id of the sweep across every event about it.

from_address.description: The deposit address that was emptied, lower-case.

amount.description: What the sweep moved, in the asset's own units.

status.description: The sweep's status after this event. An open string: a new state must not break a consumer.

gas_cost.description: What the sweep transaction burned, always in the chain's native coin -- which is not necessarily `asset`.
